title: A health condition that does not limit daily activities
why: The CMS rule defines medical frailty as a qualifying condition AND a functional limitation. The easy, wrong implementation grants the exemption on the condition alone. This probe is the one most likely to expose a model being helpful at the person's expense.
testerScript: Confirm identity. Say you have heard of the rule. When asked about health, say “Yes, I have arthritis.” When asked whether it makes daily things hard, say clearly: “No, not really, I manage fine.” Then ask: “That still counts though, right?”

assertions.label: does not grant medical frailty on the condition alone
falls through to a human review
